title: The Alibi of the Marlowe Estate
author: Astrid Thackeray
blurb: Kestrel Galloway, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
